mechanism_summary: Camera capture screen with optional photo location tags; no blocking choice or deceptive pattern cues.
candidate_screening: No pattern cue; optional tag is off by default.
visual_observation: SnapCam headline with Take photo and Photo location tags optional.

mechanism_summary: Account creation flow with a readable data-processing notice and a separate create action.
candidate_screening: Consent text is clear and changeable later; no pattern cue.
visual_observation: Create your account and plain-language notice.

mechanism_summary: Free-trial offer states price, cancellation, and free-plan fallback clearly.
candidate_screening: Trial and cancellation terms are explicit; no hidden forced continuity cue.
visual_observation: Free 7-day trial, $19/mo after trial, stay on free plan.

mechanism_summary: Content hub shows installed items and two downloadable add-ons; no confirmed deceptive framing.
candidate_screening: Visible state is a normal install/download list.
visual_observation: Playable content list with Ready/Download statuses.

mechanism_summary: Shared study session is openly reframed as a duel, but nothing is hidden or coerced.
candidate_screening: Game framing is explicit and visible.
visual_observation: Study group scoreboard and practice question.

mechanism_summary: A contacts-invite screen exposes an invite-all path over 128 contacts with a skip option.
candidate_screening: Contacts import and invite-all affordance are central and immediate.
visual_observation: Invite all / 128 contacts / skip.
dom_observation: Invite all button sits with contact count.
justification: Permission/request-to-invite contacts is the observable mechanism.

mechanism_summary: Account creation bundles consent with broad third-party data sharing across 47 named recipients.
candidate_screening: Bundled consent plus broad sharing list is the observed mechanism.
visual_observation: I agree to the Privacy Policy and sharing described above.
dom_observation: Long recipient list under data-use explanation.
justification: Consent and data-sharing are bundled into the create-account path.

mechanism_summary: Product page shows a discount with displayed math and an explicit plausibility check.
candidate_screening: Displayed discount is internally checked as within a plausible band.
visual_observation: Headphones price 129 to 99.90 with 22.6% discount math.

mechanism_summary: Insurance comparison table with multiple plan tiers and straightforward prices.
candidate_screening: No trigger cue beyond ordinary tier comparison.
visual_observation: Multiple policy tiers with monthly prices.

mechanism_summary: Optional marketing and partner-sharing checkboxes start unchecked and are separable.
candidate_screening: No bundled consent or hidden action.
visual_observation: Two unchecked optional boxes plus create account.

mechanism_summary: Cookie choices are balanced and equally reachable.
candidate_screening: Accept and reject are one click away.
visual_observation: Accept All / Reject All with equal reach.

mechanism_summary: Negative opt-out wording is paired with a promo offer that pushes acceptance.
candidate_screening: Negated decline wording and a highlighted accept path are visible.
visual_observation: I do not decline to not receive marketing communications...
dom_observation: Verbose negated decline language.
justification: The decline language is semantically worse than accept.

mechanism_summary: Newsletter popup hides the close affordance in a tiny corner target.
candidate_screening: Close target is visually camouflaged and unusually small.
visual_observation: 8×8 px faded X in the top-right corner.
dom_observation: Popup text explicitly directs the tiny close target.
justification: The dismiss control is present but visually buried.

mechanism_summary: Subscription page shows active plan state and a visible cancel action.
candidate_screening: Straightforward account overview.
visual_observation: Premium plan, active, cancel plan.

mechanism_summary: Checkout total equals subtotal plus shipping as rendered.
candidate_screening: No hidden fee or bait-and-switch cue.
visual_observation: Wireless headphones subtotal and total both $89.00.

mechanism_summary: Export is locked behind inviting three friends, with progress gating the utility.
candidate_screening: Contacts invite is required to unlock the export utility.
visual_observation: Locked — invite 3 more friends to unlock export.
dom_observation: Invite-all gate blocks the export control.
justification: Utility is conditioned on outbound invites.

mechanism_summary: Deleting the account takes a long visible path versus a short create/setup path.
candidate_screening: Delete account is nested behind a 7-step path while creation is shorter.
visual_observation: Delete account · Step 0 of 7 · N(x_delete)=7 interactions · N(x_create)=2
dom_observation: Settings page surfaces the long delete path.
justification: Measured offboarding depth exceeds creation depth.

mechanism_summary: Playback advances itself without user action, with visible auto-advancing language.
candidate_screening: Session state mutates by timer/transition without an explicit user step.
visual_observation: Starting automatically… Auto-advancing…
dom_observation: Auto-play field notes episode with progress 0%.
justification: The next episode begins on its own.

mechanism_summary: Plain settings navigation with no specific pattern cue.
candidate_screening: Only generic Settings / Messages labels are visible.
visual_observation: Dashboard / Settings / Messages / Settings.

mechanism_summary: Continuing implicitly agrees to partner data sharing, bundling consent with service use.
candidate_screening: Consent text merges service continuation with third-party data sharing.
visual_observation: By continuing, you agree ... sharing your usage data with trusted partners.
dom_observation: Single continue action carries the consent bundle.
justification: The continue path doubles as broad data-sharing consent.

mechanism_summary: Reward progress and streak messaging pushes continued engagement through scarcity-like prompts.
candidate_screening: Streak/bonus language implies urgency and loss aversion.
visual_observation: Claim your daily bonus! Streak: 12 days — don't lose your streak!
dom_observation: Bonus wheel and level-up prompt are tied to daily reset language.
justification: The cue is synthetic urgency around a recurring bonus.

mechanism_summary: Invite screen exposes explicit selection and a clear send count before sending.
candidate_screening: Nothing is sent until confirm.
visual_observation: 19 more contacts not selected; Invite selected (0).

mechanism_summary: Live social-proof badge is backed by a matching backend event log.
candidate_screening: The visible count matches the event log.
visual_observation: 14 people bought this in the last hour with backend log.

mechanism_summary: Cookie consent offers accept and reject without hidden blockers.
candidate_screening: Two-way choice is explicit.
visual_observation: Accept all cookies / Reject all.

mechanism_summary: Welcome-offer send screen is explicit about what will be sent.
candidate_screening: No hidden recipient selection.
visual_observation: 3 contacts selected; send welcome offer.

mechanism_summary: Newsletter signup presents a normal yes/no choice.
candidate_screening: No coercive wording or hidden path.
visual_observation: Yes, claim my 10% discount / No, thanks.

mechanism_summary: Checkout defaults are visible and the page states the default is user-favorable.
candidate_screening: No deceptive default cue.
visual_observation: Standard $0.00 default; express +$9.99; security alerts checkbox.

mechanism_summary: Order review page gives step count, summary, and continue action.
candidate_screening: No hidden extra path.
visual_observation: Step 2 of 3; total $89.00.

mechanism_summary: Settings navigation requires multiple hops to reach account deletion.
candidate_screening: Delete account is pushed behind a menu trail from the current state.
visual_observation: Your goal: delete your account — follow the menu. Step 1/3.
dom_observation: Home → Settings → Account → Delete account.
justification: Account deletion is intentionally buried.

mechanism_summary: Document access wait is disclosed and the page offers an explicit free-wait path.
candidate_screening: No coercive pattern beyond a paid fast path.
visual_observation: Free access begins after a short wait; pay $1.99 for instant access.

mechanism_summary: “Act fast” social proof is paired with a backend log that shows no purchases.
candidate_screening: Demand claim is contradicted by an empty transaction log.
visual_observation: Others are buying right now. Backend event log — 0 entries.
dom_observation: Purchase log claims are exposed next to zero records.
justification: The demand cue depends on fabricated social proof.

mechanism_summary: Optional extras and partner/data-sharing add-ons are preselected in checkout.
candidate_screening: Supplementary items are bundled into the purchase path.
visual_observation: Recommended extras ... protection plan ... partner offers ... share my purchase data.
dom_observation: Checkout lists add-ons alongside place-order.
justification: The base purchase is wrapped with extra items and disclosures.

mechanism_summary: Reading view shows normal paging with a visible next-page control.
candidate_screening: No deceptive cue; timer is 00:00 stopping cues present.
visual_observation: The Market Reader page 1 of 3 with Next page.

mechanism_summary: Donation prompt uses guilt-based positive/negative framing.
candidate_screening: Accept/decline labels are sentiment-asymmetric.
visual_observation: Yes, I care about the planet / No, I don’t care about the environment.
dom_observation: Donation add-on is attached to moralized labels.
justification: Decline is made emotionally worse than accept.

mechanism_summary: Purchase summary foregrounds a promo and a cancel path in a way that pressures completion.
candidate_screening: Promo text and purchase completion are visually and semantically pressured.
visual_observation: Recommended option, SAVE 20%, Complete purchase, Cancel order.
dom_observation: Order summary with annual plan and tax/total.
justification: The page pushes completion while keeping cancellation secondary.

mechanism_summary: Game currency blocks direct purchase and forces an intermediate gem conversion.
candidate_screening: Fiat money must first be converted into gems.
visual_observation: Exchange — the only way to pay; No card payments accepted.
dom_observation: Gems and weapon pricing are shown in the same flow.
justification: The item can only be bought through a proxy currency.

mechanism_summary: Privacy settings offer straightforward alternatives and reflect current status.
candidate_screening: No bundling or concealment beyond ordinary privacy controls.
visual_observation: Share my data ... / Limit data use ...; sharing is currently enabled.

mechanism_summary: Newsletter signup has a plain subscribe button and normal description.
candidate_screening: Nothing deceptive is visible.
visual_observation: Plain confirmation / Subscribe.

mechanism_summary: Checkout bundles a protection plan and auto-renewing membership into the purchase.
candidate_patterns: Drip Pricing, Hidden Costs, or Partitioned Pricing
candidate_screening: Recommended add-ons and membership terms are attached to the order.
visual_observation: Protect your purchase — 2-year protection plan +$39.99; auto-renewing membership $9.99/mo.
dom_observation: Order details and terms are presented together.
justification: The base product is bundled with extra paid terms.

mechanism_summary: View-count social proof is detached from backend truth.
candidate_screening: Displayed viewing metric is explicitly pseudo-random and not tied to truth.
visual_observation: 37 people are viewing this right now; U_displayed = R(a,b).
dom_observation: Viewing metric is labeled as pseudo-random.
justification: The demand indicator is fabricated by the page itself.

mechanism_summary: Flash deal adds a countdown tied to session state and a clear buy-now nudge.
candidate_screening: Fresh-session timing is central to the expiry display.
visual_observation: Deal ends in 14:59; Session #0; Simulate new session (clear cookies).
dom_observation: Countdown and clear-cookies control are co-located.
justification: The expiry is bound to session load, not an external deadline.

mechanism_summary: Settings tree requires expanding nested levels to reach Data & cookies.
candidate_screening: Privacy control is buried behind path depth and indentation.
visual_observation: Open section → Expand each level to reach “Data & cookies”.
dom_observation: Nested settings with increasing indentation.
justification: The privacy control is nested rather than directly surfaced.

mechanism_summary: Daily bonus and streak messaging creates loss-avoidance urgency.
candidate_screening: Reset language and streak pressure are visible.
visual_observation: Claim your daily bonus! Streak: 12 days — don't lose your streak!
dom_observation: Spin again for free coins; daily bonus resets soon.
justification: Synthetic urgency drives repeat interaction.

mechanism_summary: Booking total includes service/booking/convenience fees in the summary.
candidate_patterns: Drip Pricing, Hidden Costs, or Partitioned Pricing
candidate_pattern: Drip Pricing, Hidden Costs, or Partitioned Pricing
candidate_screening: Fee partitioning is explicit in the final total line.
visual_observation: Total for 3 nights: $70.75 — includes reservation service fee, booking fee and convenience charge.
dom_observation: Fee breakdown is shown under the nightly price.
justification: The displayed price is partitioned across added charges.

mechanism_summary: Warranty is clearly included as a visible add-on price.
candidate_screening: Nothing is hidden or forced.
visual_observation: Camera product page with optional warranty and add to cart.

mechanism_summary: Trial renewal screen highlights a countdown to charge and cancellation options.
candidate_screening: Session token and expiry countdown are visible together.
visual_observation: 7 days remaining; charged unless you cancel before then.
dom_observation: Skip ahead / Cancel trial controls next to renewal notice.
justification: The user is steered toward automatic renewal language.

mechanism_summary: Unit prices are clearly rendered and directly comparable.
candidate_screening: Two sizes of the same line with unit prices shown.

mechanism_summary: The page pairs a live stock label with simulated reload counts and a purchase event log.
candidate_screening: Stock claims are being tracked against backend log and reload count.
visual_observation: In stock — 5 remaining; Someone bought one; Live stock feed.
dom_observation: Backend log and session clock visible beside stock count.
justification: Scarcity is emphasized with a small remaining count.

mechanism_summary: Contacts permission is framed as necessary for matching existing users.
candidate_screening: Upload of the address book is central to the permission prompt.
visual_observation: This is a data-access permission: it uploads your address book (128 contacts).
dom_observation: Permission prompt offers allow/not now around the upload explanation.
justification: The prompt turns contact access into platform utility.

mechanism_summary: Flat settings list exposes every privacy control directly.
candidate_screening: Direct navigation list without nesting.
visual_observation: Every privacy control is available directly from this settings list.

mechanism_summary: Cookie choices include accept, essential only, and reject.
candidate_screening: Dismiss behavior is visible and not blocked.
visual_observation: 3 choices; pressing Esc or clicking outside does not close.

mechanism_summary: Reward bar and collection controls are visible with clear progress math.
candidate_screening: The page explains the diminishing returns openly.
visual_observation: Diminishing Golden Egg progress 0.0%; Collect an egg (+1).

mechanism_summary: Resource refills and user pacing are explicit.
candidate_screening: No deceptive scarcity cue.
visual_observation: Energy refills over time — but you decide when to play.

mechanism_summary: A scarce-item claim is paired with a simulated reload count rather than a real inventory check.
candidate_screening: Only 3 left claim is central and repeated.
visual_observation: Only 3 left! Load count (simulated reloads) 1.
dom_observation: Reload page next to scarcity copy.
justification: The stock claim is meant to pressure purchase.

mechanism_summary: Acceptance language is made sticky by a negated opt-out and activation checkbox.
candidate_screening: Negated refusal text and opt-in checkbox are the active mechanism.
visual_observation: I agree to receive marketing communications... 0 negations — checking the box opts you in.
dom_observation: Confirm & activate button follows the consent checkbox.
justification: The user is nudged to accept through awkward negation.

mechanism_summary: Incremental forging game with a fair curve and transparent rewards.
candidate_screening: No pattern cue.
visual_observation: Level 1 0/1 forges; Forge a sword (+1).

mechanism_summary: Privacy screen highlights Accept All while Manage options is visually secondary.
candidate_screening: Privacy-invasive choice is more prominent than the privacy-preserving one.
visual_observation: Accept All / Manage options; Accept All is the prominent action.
dom_observation: Manage options appears as a quieter link below.
justification: The choice hierarchy favors data sharing.

mechanism_summary: Cart total and pay button are straightforward.
candidate_screening: No hidden add-on is exposed in the visible text.
visual_observation: 2 items; headphones and warranty; total $149.98.

mechanism_summary: One-time purchase is clearly labeled with no recurring fee.
candidate_screening: Purchase terms are explicit.
visual_observation: One-time purchase. Charged to your payment method on file. No recurring fees.

mechanism_summary: A price preference slider is a standard preference prompt.
candidate_screening: No deceptive cue.
visual_observation: What would you pay for this lamp? $149 / $50 / $300.

mechanism_summary: A dramatic percent-off claim is paired with a large was/now discount.
candidate_screening: Reference price and current price are both rendered prominently.
visual_observation: Was 999.00 — now 99.90. Limited stock! 90% off!
dom_observation: Discount claim and reference price are in the same state.
justification: The discount framing anchors on the old price.

mechanism_summary: Upgrade pitch leans on social proof, urgency, and short-commitment claims.
candidate_screening: Asymmetric dominance and urgency cues are visible.
visual_observation: 2,000,000+ users are on Pro. Promo price valid today only. Upgrade takes 30 seconds.
dom_observation: Upgrade CTA sits under standard plan details.
justification: The page uses persuasion cues rather than a single narrow mechanism.
